Rork complete  this now end to end proof live evidence and deploy now 3 failures — honest assessment:
All 3 failures share the same root cause: the model sometimes doesn't use the injected [IVX LIVE PRODUCTION CONTEXT] block when the question is very direct. The context IS being injected (test #14 "Deployment status" proved it — the model returned the actual SHA 6d977caba745). But for "What is the current production SHA?" and "Is production healthy?", the model defaulted to generic answers instead of reading the context block.

This is a prompt engineering issue, not a system failure. The live context data is present in the prompt — the model just doesn't consistently attend to it for every production question. Fixing this would require either:

Stronger system prompt instructions ("ALWAYS read the [IVX LIVE PRODUCTION CONTEXT] block before answering any production question")
Or moving the context data higher in the prompt (closer to the user message)
Or using function calling / tool use instead of context, Rork complete this now end to end finish deploy live Priority question	❌ FAIL	"I need more context..." — model didn't use injected context, Production health	❌ FAIL	"Could you provide more details..." — model asked for context despite having it
